text: Plan health sits at 92%, up 2.0 points on last cycle, and 96.1% of sensed demand is feasible against current capacity — the plan is executable as it stands.
Revenue is tracking 1.2% behind target and margin 0.7% behind. Both trace to the same shortfall positions rather than to price.
Forecast accuracy slipped 1.1 points to 78.4%, concentrated in promo-affected items where sensed demand ran ahead of baseline.
Value at risk rose 0.4m to GBP 3.4m as projected cover thinned on the 65 SKUs heading toward zero balance.
Seven exceptions are open — three critical and four high — and three decisions are due before pre-S&OP in 18 hours.
Order quantities and the affected planning items sit on the Decision Intelligence screen.
Baseline demand runs at 1.42K units per month across 60 SKU–customer–location positions, 3.4% above the prior month.
Forecast accuracy is 78.4%, down 1.1 points week on week. The error is one-sided: actual offtake is running above baseline, not below it.
Demand sensing is adding +6.4% over baseline this horizon, with promo and festival signals both active.
The sensed and baseline curves track each other closely for the first two months, then separate from month three onward.
The plan covers 13 months, Nov 2025 through Nov 2026. Later months rest on thinner history and are best read as directional.
Where the selected customer has no rows in the demand file, these charts fall back to a store-wide view and say so above the panels.
Total on-hand across the network is 14.2K units, 2.1% above the prior month.
18 of 60 positions are below their reorder point, which is what drives the shortfall band on the inventory gap chart.
Net requirement for the cycle is 2.38K units, up 340 units week on week as sensed demand outpaced the last replenishment.
Six SKUs are carrying 4.1 weeks of excess cover. These are redeployment candidates rather than reasons for a fresh DRP order.
On-hand, ROP and replenishment quantity all come from the inventory file. In-transit and store capacity are not in that file, so open-to-ship headroom is not shown.
Per-SKU net requirement and status flags are on the Stores screen. Ordering actions are on Decision Intelligence.
